sentences.text: This video can not be played Watch: What the Paramount and Warner Bros deal means for you It has been months in the making but Paramount Skydance has finally completed its $110bn (£82.8bn) merger with Warner Bros Discovery.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The deal welds two legacy Hollywood powerhouses, uniting franchises like Harry Potter and Game of Thrones, into an entertainment behemoth named Skydance.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Yet behind this milestone lies strict rules about what the combined business can and cannot do - from how many films it must produce a year to the editorial independence of its newsroom.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Here are four ways this could affect you and the movies, TV and news you watch.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: HBO Max is the company behind Euphoria, a series starring Zendaya Warner Bros owns HBO Max, home to The Sopranos, House of the Dragon and Euphoria among others.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Meanwhile, Paramount Skydance has Paramount+, which streams the likes of Yellowstone, Parks and Recreation and NCIS.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Combining HBO Max and Paramount+ into a single platform or bundle will likely squeeze subscribers' wallets over time.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: While existing subscribers to both might enjoy short-term savings, analysts expect overall prices to rise as the combined giant seeks profitability .
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The merged company, Skydance, carries a massive $80bn in debt from the deal, even as executives target $6bn in annual cost savings.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Analysts warn that consumers will ultimately bear the financial burden of the $110bn deal.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Mike Proulx, research director at Forrester, noted that with streaming services constantly raising fees to increase profitability and Skydance saddled with massive debt, price increases are likely to come.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: While viewers will gain access to a broader catalogue, as Skydance shifts toward a Paramount+ and HBO Max bundle rather than a single app, Proulx warns that "it's far-fetched to think it'll prevent downstream price hikes".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Paramount and Warner Bros are coming together to form Skydance As part of a settlement deal with US states who had objected to the merger , Paramount Skydance has agreed to release a set number of films every year for the next five years.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: For the first two years, that's 30 movies annually, and for the remaining period it has to release 32 films each year.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: That's 156 movies in total - and the majority have to be "wide releases," meaning they must be shown in cinemas.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The merged studio must also release at least four independent films each year.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: If Skydance misses its movie quota, it could be forced to sell its 49% stake in Miramax – the studio co-founded by disgraced Hollywood mogul Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Breanne Gilliam, a corporate lawyer at Maddin Hauser, said the film commitment is meaningful, even if it comes with an expiration date.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "Once those obligations expire, the company will have far more flexibility," she said.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "Temporary rules cannot permanently fix a structural market shift".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Once the five-year deal ends, Skydance could follow rivals like Disney and Netflix by prioritizing streaming over cinema.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: As Disney's $71bn buyout of 21st Century Fox in 2019 proved, mega-deals can lead to fewer films in cinemas.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Before the acquisition, 20th Century Fox routinely released 12 to 17 movies annually in theatres, but under Disney that slate scaled down to just three to six a year.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Members of the film and TV industry protested outside Paramount Studios in LA For those working behind the scenes, the merger of two historic studios has been described as a "disaster" by those on the ground.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Actors and writers recently gathered at Paramount Studios in Los Angeles to oppose the deal, accusing regulators of failing to protect industry livelihoods.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Criminal Minds star Kirsten Vangsness told the BBC she was "heartbroken".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "It's people that make this city," she said.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "It's people that make entertainment,  it's the everyday creatives that this industry is built on - this is who it hurts." A report by consultancy CVL Economics for LA County estimated the merger could eliminate roughly 4,500 direct film and TV jobs, while causing $1.26bn in lost wages over three years.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The blow could hit a region that has already lost roughly a third of its film and TV workforce, about 50,000 jobs, since 2022.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Syleecia Thompson, a business professor at National University, said that "it hits small businesses, vendors, caterers and local communities".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: She warned that Hollywood may become less of a "single location" and more of a "dispersed network." Although the settlement establishes a workforce fund to retrain displaced workers, lawyers note it does not block job cuts.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "Nothing in the settlement limits layoffs," attorney Gilliam added.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: CNN White House correspondent Betsy Klein reports from outside the building To address concerns over journalistic independence at CNN and CBS, the settlement creates a news editorial independence board that will be appointed directly by Paramount.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: The $110bn deal brings two major US television news operations under a single corporate roof.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Before the deal, Paramount owned CBS News, and Warner Bros. owned CNN.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Both networks have faced intense political pressure - CNN was one of a handful of news organisations banned from the White House by President Donald Trump - as well as leadership shifts amid broader industry consolidation.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: CBS News's editor-in-chief Bari Weiss will remain in her role.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Yet as Paramount targets billions in cost cuts across the merged company, staff fear the consolidation will trigger significant job losses at CNN and CBS.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Beyond potential workforce reductions, media advocates and legal experts remain deeply skeptical about whether it can ensure newsroom freedom.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Seth Stern, chief of advocacy at Freedom of the Press Foundation, described the Paramount-appointed board as "worthless".
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "The board creates the same First Amendment problems it claims to solve, the government meddling in news," Stern said.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Gilliam agrees paper promises mean little without real authority.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: "An oversight board only has as much power as the agreement gives it.
sentences.article_title: From films to streaming prices - how the Warner Bros deal could affect you

sentences.text: Oversight without authority is just observation," she said.

sentences.text: Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma has been crowned king of Uganda's Tooro kingdom.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The new monarch has long been a familiar face in the East African nation, where for many he was known not as the heir to the throne, but as a storyteller: a long-serving anchor and editor at the state broadcaster.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But the 56-year-old - now King Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Nyabongo I - has become the subject of media attention himself as his rise to the Tooro throne sparked controversy and widespread reactions beyond the country.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Tooro is one of Uganda's four main officially recognised historical kingdoms.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: For the last 31 years, it had been headed by King Oyo Nyimba Kabamba Iguru Rukidi IV, who was once known as a "boy king", after ascending to the throne as an infant.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Oyo became king in 1995 at the age of just three, following the death of his father.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Then the world's youngest monarch, he ruled until he died last month from cancer, aged just 34.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: This video can not be played King Edward Rukidi Kijanangoma Nyabongo I promised to unite his people at his coronation The coronation is a day for celebration, involving traditional practices that started at midnight.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma has had to perform various ceremonies and walk about 4km (2.5 miles) to the official Karuziika royal palace where he has now been crowned.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The Tooro kingdom's Information Minister Charles Mwanguhya told the BBC Focus on Africa podcast that a mock fight would follow his crowning, to signify that kingship does not come easy.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma would then be blessed by members of the royal Babiito clan, he said.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But his selection was far from straightforward.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: According to tradition, a recognised son of the late king should have succeeded him.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Close members of the royal family said Oyo had left a young son and a will with instructions that the child should be next on the throne.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But the son has never been revealed to the public and nor was he recognised by the committee of 21 Babiito clan members who choose the king and eventually selected Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The late King Oyo was never publicly married, and little is known about his wife or their son.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Nonetheless his mother, Queen Best Kemigisa, argued that the late king's will ought to have been respected.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: However, the royal succession committee ignored her wishes, insisting their selection process was conducted in accordance with Tooro customs and traditions.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The new king has thus found himself at the centre of a succession dispute, with Kemigisa and her close relatives unhappy with the outcome.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The late King Oyo's mother has expressed her pain over the succession row Kemigisa referred to Kijanangoma's selection as the "announcement of a second king" being "made after the will of King Oyo was read to members of the royal family".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "As a mother, that was extraordinarily painful," she said, describing celebrations for the next king taking place "only metres from where my son's body lay".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The queen later said Oyo's son, who was in the US state of Texas, had been due to return home but that could not happen amid a "tense and polarised succession dispute".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "No child should be placed in circumstances where returning to his father's homeland could mean being drawn into hostility and conflict," Kemigisa asserted in a post on X.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: But according to the Tooro kingdom's information minister, the son being talked about "hasn't been presented anywhere, which means there is a growing acceptance that sad as it may be, King Oyo didn't leave a son behind".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: While King Oyo inherited the crown from his father, Mwanguhya told the BBC "the crown has moved to a different line within the ruling clan".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: A king must come from the Babiito clan, specifically the lineage of King George David Matthew Kamurasi Rukidi III, according to royal palace sources.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma and the late King Oyo are cousins.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Both are grandsons of Rukidi III, the 11th king, or Omukama, who ruled the Tooro kingdom from 1928 to 1965.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma was among several people who were considered for the role, including Prince George Desmond Kamurasi, who plays football for one of the UK's best-known amateur clubs .
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: According to the succession committee, the South East Dons captain and goalkeeper declined the offer of the throne, citing other responsibilities.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: After he was formally announced, Kijanangoma promised that the palace would be open to the people, while vowing to focus on unity and development.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "I ask you for one thing - they have given me this title as king but I cannot work alone, I have to work with you," he said.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: President Museveni (left), who restored the traditional kingdoms in the 1990s, was pictured with Tooro's King Oyo (right) in 2010 Uganda's traditional kings have no formal political authority, but they retain cultural influence and command significant loyalty in the communities they lead.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The country is home to four main kingdoms, the largest and most prominent being Buganda in the central region, which encompasses the capital Kampala.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The kingdoms were abolished in 1967, but the government under President Yoweri Museveni restored them in the early 1990s.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The government said this was to promote cultural pride and national unity, but the move has also been interpreted as a way of appeasing communities and fostering political loyalty.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Amid the succession dispute, the government backed the Babiito clan's choice of Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Attorney General Sam Mayanja said the Tooro kingdom was cleared to go ahead with the coronation, as there had not been a formal complaint against him.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The date of the coronation was announced by the government with President Museveni attending the ceremony.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The president's son and the head of the military, Muhoozi Kainerugaba, has also publicly supported Kijanangoma.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "Long may he reign," he posted on X.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma's very name points to his royal heritage.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: His father, the first Kijanangoma, was born in the year King Rukidi III became king.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The king gave him the name, which means the "one who comes with the royal drum".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: The drum of royalty, foretold two generations earlier, is now returning to its bearer.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma was born in 1970 and raised at their family home at Kidukuru village in Fort Portal, about 300km (186 miles) from Kampala.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: He left the village to pursue further studies and graduated with a mass communication degree from Uganda's prestigious Makerere University in 1999.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: He worked as a broadcaster in a career spanning more than two decades, including in neighbouring Rwanda and at home, with the Uganda Broadcasting Corporation (UBC).
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: Kijanangoma has been a journalist for much of his adult life The years spent engaging with the public, the interactions with leaders and the exposure to national affairs in his work as a journalist may yet serve him well as he returns to the community he came from, this time as their leader.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: After he was named king, Kijanangoma said he would use the connections he had built up over 21 years working as a journalist "to get good things for our people".
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: His mother, Assimwe Yusta Kijanangoma, is confident that he is well prepared for his new role.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: She says his upbringing was deeply rooted in tradition.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: "I really raised him with the teachings of the old kingdom of a cane and instructions and scolding.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: I laugh with him, and other times I scold him," she told the BBC.
sentences.article_title: The journalist crowned king in Uganda after bitter succession dispute

sentences.text: She added: "Eddy is well-mannered, he does not fight, or shout, even when wronged, he says a few words and does not go so much into it." She feels good for her son, although she admits to having mixed emotions, especially as her son is taking over after the death of a "great man".

sentences.text: Nigerian police, pictured at the site of a previous abduction in June, said they rescued the young people A group of 20 young people who were abducted in south-east Nigeria last week have been rescued, police say.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The graduates were kidnapped on 1 October while they were travelling for a national community service programme in the Abia and Akwa Ibom states in the south of the country.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: They were rescued by the police with the assistance of other security agencies.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: Police spokesman Ani Iniedu said in a statement on Wednesday the group were rescued at Amakohia Ubi in Imo State after a sustained search-and-rescue operation.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The group are being looked after and have been taken for medical evaluation.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The police, military and other security agencies conducted intelligence-led searches of forests and suspected hideouts, he said, but he did not say whether any ransom was paid or if any arrests had been made.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: But the police spokesman did say they were making efforts to apprehend the perpetrators and bring them to justice.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The police had previously said they had identified the location where the group was being held but could not rescue them because it was mined with explosives.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The group of young people were participating in the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC), which is a compulsory one-year community service programme for most Nigerian university graduates, where people are posted to different parts of the country.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The group were travelling in two buses travelling on a major highway from Ibadan in south-western Oyo state to NYSC orientation camps in Abia and Akwa Ibom states when gunmen attacked the vehicles.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The incident has reignited concerns over insecurity and kidnapping along roads in the south-east.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: Before they were released, the father of one of the people who were abducted, Omotosho Adewale, told the BBC that the kidnappers had demanded a ransom of 50m naira ($37,680; £28,440), which he could not afford.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: "There's no peace of mind.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: I've not eaten in three days," he said in between tears.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: Kidnapping for ransom is a major security problem in Nigeria, involving criminal gangs and armed groups.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The authorities have not released any information about the identity of the attackers.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: The government has outlawed paying ransoms to kidnappers in an attempt to remove the incentive for the gangs but this has had little effect.
sentences.article_title: Group of 20 graduates rescued after being abducted in Nigeria

sentences.text: Amid drumming and dancing, Boateng Bismark James leads 13 worshippers, nine men and four women, in prayer for drivers and passengers travelling to destinations across Ghana.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Ghana is a predominantly Christian country where preaching on public transport is widespread.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: On long-distance buses, pastors can often be seen - and heard - preaching the gospel.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Sometimes they stand in the stairwell next to the driver, at others they walk up and down the aisle reading from the Bible and calling on sinners to repent at the tops of their voices.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: They do not stop even if the trip lasts for several hours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The faithful sometimes offer money to the preachers to support their endeavours.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But a new law means this familiar practice could be coming to an end.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Anyone found preaching in public service vehicles faces up to eight months in prison, a fine of up to $52 (£39) or both.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new regulation, passed by parliament in May, and which has started to be enforced in recent weeks, targets preaching and hawking on vehicles while they are in motion, classifying both as a nuisance and citing the safety and comfort of passengers.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng, a 61-year-old pastor at Gospel Light church, has been preaching on commercial vehicles leaving Neoplan station since 2023.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I preach on commercial vehicles because not everyone is able to go to church on Sunday.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: There are a lot of passengers who need our message of salvation to repent from their sins.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We even heal the sick on some buses," he told the BBC in Twi, a local language.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Wearing a clerical collared shirt, Boateng moves through rows of buses loading passengers before boarding one bound for Kumasi, Ghana's second-largest city.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: We speak to him before the bus departs to avoid breaking the law.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some travellers listen closely as he delivers his message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Others try to ignore him, browsing their phones, making calls or chatting among themselves.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "Some passengers are very happy with my message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some even say they have never heard the message in church, but through my preaching they now know it is in the Bible," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng Bismark James and his group start preaching at the bus station before boarding the vehicles The new rules have divided opinion.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Critics say preaching on moving vehicles is a nuisance and a safety risk, as it could distract the driver, while supporters argue that evangelism is a Christian duty and should be protected under the freedom of religious worship.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: One woman in her early 30s, who wishes to be identified as Chery Lokko, says she prefers to travel in peace. ''I don't like it because they are a nuisance.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Some of them spit saliva on you unconsciously, especially if you are seated not far from them, and they are a nuisance in terms of noise and saliva.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: I like my peace whenever I'm on public transport.'' In one video widely shared on social media recently, a passenger on a minibus is seen angrily confronting a pastor attempting to board.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "Get down, I say get down," he shouts.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But in this devout country, ranked among the most religious in the world , external , others say evangelism on public transport is an important way of reaching people who may not attend church.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Bernice Nartey, a passenger travelling to Kumasi, says pastors should be allowed to preach, but only with passengers' consent.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "The preaching sometimes helps people to repent.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: For instance, if someone is going through a stressful situation, the message of the pastor can give the person renewed hope," she says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Boateng says he was shaken by the regulation and wants religious preachers to be given an exemption.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "We are very worried, because most pastors here depend on preaching to take care of their families through the monetary gifts offered by passengers," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "The government should allow us to preach on the buses and alight when it is exiting Accra," he adds.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: For Boateng, preaching is not only a religious calling but also an important source of income.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "I have been able to take care of my children's education.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Preaching on commercial buses was first prohibited in Ghana in 2012, with offenders facing up to 30 days in prison.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: But enforcement was weak and so the practice remained common, particularly on buses.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The new law beefs up the penalties for those that flout the ban.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Preachers using megaphones can also often be seen and heard at Ghana's lorry parks and markets but they are not affected by the ban.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: The Christian Council of Ghana did not respond to the BBC's request for a comment but Rev Enoch Paul Hayes, a senior pastor at one of the biggest churches in Ghana, the International Central Gospel Church, tells the BBC he does not think the new rules infringe on religious freedom.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: He urges his fellow pastors not to break the law, saying they should find other ways of spreading their message.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: "There is social media as an alternative outlet, where the same message can reach thousands of people," he says.
sentences.article_title: Why pastors may not be seen - or heard - preaching on Ghana's buses for much longer

sentences.text: Naomi Korir's entry into athletics was impacted by congenital fistula, a condition she lived with for 13 years Naomi Korir's career on the track reached a high point in August when she finished fifth in the final of the mile at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: But things could have been very different for the Kenyan middle-distance runner.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: The 28-year-old was born with fistula, a medical condition in which abnormal openings develop between organs and can lead to uncontrolled leakage of urine or faeces.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: While Korir loved athletics as a child, it initially forced her to rethink any plans to be a runner.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "I played most of the sports activities: football, netball, athletics, even rugby," she said.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "But it was difficult because [of] the training, and the urine is flowing continuously.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "I reduced my running to shorter distances to reduce the leaking.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "I began doing 100m hurdles." Despite the challenges, Korir's love of sport also offered a form of escape and belonging.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "I could do it because I loved it," she explained.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: Some develop a fistula after childbirth while for others, like Korir, it is congenital.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: Access to good obstetrics, or to simple surgery, means that the condition has all but disappeared in some countries, but it remains a problem in sub-Saharan Africa, where high quality medical care can be hard to access.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: Korir was born with genitourinary tract fistula - an opening between bladder and vagina which caused her urine leakage.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: Surgery was required, but her first two operations failed to solve the problem.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: In August 2013, a third operation finally brought relief for the then 13-year-old.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: The procedure was carried out in her home town Eldoret by the Gynocare Hospital, which specialises in fistula, obstetrics and reproductive health.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "It's a difficult condition to live with every day," Gynocare director Caroline Mabeya told BBC Sport Africa when discussing the stigma and isolation women with the condition suffer.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "They are ostracised in the society.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: That's the psychological torture that they face with the fistula." The hospital has treated patients from across East Africa since opening its doors in 2011.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: Its work extends beyond surgery, with a post-operation programme designed to help women rebuild their confidence.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "We offer free treatment for these women at Gynocare because most of them are very poor," Mabeya explained.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "When they come into the facility, they are crushed, they have low esteem.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: As well as allowing her to run properly again, she continued her education through Gynocare's Beyond Fistula programme.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

In 2019, Korir began competing professionally and two years later was part of the Kenyan duo which claimed a silver medal in the 2x2x400m mixed relay alongside her partner Ferguson Rotich at the World Relays in Poland.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: A year later she went one better, bagging gold as part of Kenya's 4x400m relay team at the African Championships in Mauritius.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: The mile at this year's Commonwealth Games was her first appearance in major global final.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "I'm giving hope to young women maybe who have lost hope," she said of her achievements.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "She makes them realise that you can actually pull yourself out of these struggles and still make it in life and succeed.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: "Naomi actually is one of those patients that inspires us to continue working very hard, because we struggle with this condition and these women.
sentences.article_title: 'I reduced my running because of urine leaks' – Commonwealth finalist Korir

sentences.text: The work is not easy." As a young girl, Korir sang in church and played the keyboard, convinced that music was a more likely career than athletics.

sentences.text: The volume of oil flowing from the Middle East region has almost returned to pre-war levels, data shows, despite the continued restrictions Iran is placing on vessels attempting to travel through the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Seven months after the US-Israel war with Iran led to the effective closure of the critical waterway, the maritime intelligence firm Kpler said that in the final week of September, daily oil flow from the Middle East reached 92% of its pre-war baseline.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: About 40% of the total oil exported from the region in September bypassed the strait and exited via overland pipelines to ports on the Red Sea or the Gulf of Oman, up from 17% before the war, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Oil exports from Iran, on the other hand, have ground to a halt after the reimposition of a US naval blockade in July.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: The US military has been supporting ships as they pass through the Strait of Hormuz since at least mid-June and US Navy data shows the number of vessels assisted by US forces is up by a third in September compared with August.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Martin Kelly, senior intelligence analyst at security firm EOS Risk Group, told BBC Verify that US support is primarily in the form of "air support to ships", including through issuing warnings and intercepting incoming threats from drones, missiles or boats.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: But ships moving through the US-recommended southern route of the strait near the coast of Oman, rather than seeking permission to use Iran's northern route, continue to be targeted.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: September saw the highest number of successful Iranian attacks on commercial shipping since March, according to the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data conflict monitor.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Naveen Das, a senior oil analyst from Kpler, said the oil market "doesn't trust that we're going stay in this status quo" because of the geopolitical risk of further Iranian escalation and the possible impact of the US midterm elections.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Most of the oil passing through the strait now moves via a "shuttle system" of more than 60 large oil tankers moving back and forth, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: More than 70% of the crude oil which passed through the strait in August was transferred from these "shuttle tankers" onto other vessels in the Gulf of Oman, Kpler said.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: BBC Verify has analysed satellite imagery which appears to show these ship-to-ship transfers, taking place off the coast of the Omani port city, Sohar.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Imagery taken on 24 September shows six pairs of ships docked or paired together near the port, seemingly more protected from Iranian attack.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: But there is "a question over how long these ships can last", said Martin Kelly, particularly as attacks on them continue.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: An average of more than four million barrels of oil per day was transferred from ship to ship in the Gulf of Oman over in the week to 30 September, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Overall, an average of 12 million barrels of oil per day passed through the strait over this period, compared with a pre-war baseline of 17 million.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Oil exporting countries in the Gulf have also responded to Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz by exporting more crude oil overland via pipelines.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Just under 20% of crude is now leaving the region from ports on the Red Sea at the end of Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, which is recording exports of more than four million barrels per day, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Three weeks after an attack on this pipeline blamed on Iran-backed proxies in Iraq, Saudi Arabia is now exporting through the pipeline at "full stretch", according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Almost a quarter of all crude flowing from the region is now being piped past the Strait of Hormuz to terminals along the Gulf of Oman, particularly the city of Fujairah in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Kpler's data shows.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Naveen Das from Kpler said this increased use of pipelines is likely to become the "new normal" because "it seems very improbable that we live in a world whereby the Gulf countries and Iran go back to being relatively harmonious".
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Oil exports from Iran have fallen almost to zero following the re-imposition of a US blockade in mid-July, down from 1.7 million barrels a day before the war began, Kpler data shows.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: There are 20 empty Iran-flagged tankers currently off the coast of Sri Lanka, unable to return to the Gulf due to the US blockade, according to ship-tracking data and analysis from the US-based advocacy and monitoring organisation United Against Nuclear Iran.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: While crude oil flow from the Middle East has resumed to almost normal levels, exports of liquified natural gas and oil products like jet fuel and have remained well below pre-conflict volumes.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Fewer than a million barrels of processed oil products passed through the Strait of Hormuz on average in the last week, down from 3.5 million per day before the war began.
